column1: # THE FIELD USED FOR PLANNING IS `volume` - the 12-month average. `volume_monthly`
# (latest month) is printed beside it so the two are never mistaken for a conflict.
# CHANGE SINCE CONT-07 (27 Aug 2026): "barang hantaran" read 350 then and 500 now,
# one day apart, same field. The 12-month average moves as months roll off. The
# parent_topic assignments are unchanged - all seven still sit on one parent.
# traffic_potential is IDENTICAL (2,400-2,500) across every member of the parent,
# and 2,700 across every member of the other. It is a parent-level figure, so it
# carries no information about whether the children should be split.
